description: Negen zwaardere opdrachten op een groter testproject (Trip Expenses: 4 schermen, models, opslag met versies, balansberekening, go_router met parameters). Elke taak heeft een verborgen gedragstest die pas NA de run wordt geschreven, zodat het model hem niet ziet; de ontwerp-taken (h06, h07) controleren ook formaat, tikdoel en overflow op een smalle telefoon met grote tekst.

tasks.prompt: Show every amount with a euro sign, like €12.50, on the trips list, on the trip screen (the total and every expense) and on the balances screen. Use one shared helper in core for this, so that the screens do not format money themselves.
Bug: when I delete an expense from a trip, sometimes a different expense disappears. Please find the cause and fix it.

Every expense gets a currency, 'EUR' by default. Add a `currency` String field to Expense (named parameter `currency`, default 'EUR'), save and load it, bump the storage version to 2, and make sure data that was saved by the old version (storage version 1, without currency) can still be loaded and gets 'EUR'. Add a test for the migration.

Add an expense detail screen on the route /trip/:id/expense/:expenseId that shows the title, the amount, who paid and the date. Tapping an expense in the trip's list opens it. The existing route /trip/:id/expense/new must keep working.

Refactor the money math in core: put it in one new file lib/core/logic/money_math.dart with a function `List<int> splitEvenly(int cents, int parts)`. Splitting 1000 cents between 3 gives [334, 333, 333] (the extra cents go to the first people). Make netBalances use it, so the balances of a trip always add up to exactly zero, even when the total does not divide evenly. Do not change how the app looks.

Redesign the empty state of the trips list: when there are no trips yet, show a large icon, a friendly sentence and a prominent button 'Create your first trip' that opens the same new-trip dialog as the + button. It must also look right on a small 320 px wide phone and with large text.

On the balances screen, show each payment as a card with the text '<Name> pays <Name>', the amount and a 'Mark as paid' button. Marking a payment as paid removes that card and updates the balances of those two people, so that once everything is paid the screen says 'All settled.' The paid state must be kept when I leave the screen and come back. Keep it readable on a 320 px wide phone.

Let me mark trips as favorites. Add a star icon button on every trip in the trips list and in the top bar of the trip screen. Its tooltip is 'Favorite' when the trip is not a favorite and 'Unfavorite' when it is. Favorite trips are shown first in the list.
Bug: after I add an expense to a trip, the total shown for that trip on the trips list stays the same until I restart the app. Find out why and fix it.
